*   1/2 cup unsalted butter, chilled and cubed
*   1 cup fresh or frozen blueberries
*   1 large egg
*   1/2 cup heavy cream
*   1 teaspoon vanilla extract
*   Zest of 1 lemon

**Instructions:**

5.  **Whisk** together the egg, heavy cream, vanilla, and lemon zest in a separate bowl.
6.  **Combine:** Pour wet ingredients into dry and stir until just combined.
7.  **Shape:** Turn dough onto a floured surface and shape into a 1-inch thick circle.
8.  **Cut** into 8 wedges and place on the baking sheet.
9.  **Optional:** Brush tops with cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
10. **Bake** for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
11. **Cool** on a wire rack before serving.

data.content:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

A delightful recipe for flaky, buttery blueberry scones with a hint of lemon zest.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, chilled and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh or frozen blueberries
  • 1 large egg
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Zest of 1 lemon

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the chilled butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in the blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together egg, heavy cream, vanilla extract, and lemon zest.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a floured surface and shape into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
  11. Cool on a wire rack before serving.

Enjoy these scones warm with clotted cream or your favorite jam!

I have successfully navigated to the Blueberry Scones recipe on Coded Culinary. Here is the recipe for you:

### **Blueberry Scones Recipe**
A delightful recipe for flaky, buttery blueberry scones with a hint of lemon zest.

**Ingredients:**
*   2 cups all-purpose flour
*   1/3 cup granulated sugar
*   1 tablespoon baking powder
*   1/2 teaspoon salt
*   1/2 cup unsalted butter, chilled and cubed
*   1 cup fresh or frozen blueberries
*   1 large egg
*   1/2 cup heavy cream
*   1 teaspoon vanilla extract
*   Zest of 1 lemon

**Instructions:**
1.  **Preheat** oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2.  **Whisk** together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl.
3.  **Cut in** the chilled butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
4.  **Fold in** the blueberries gently.
5.  **Whisk** together the egg, heavy cream, vanilla extract, and lemon zest in a separate bowl.
6.  **Combine:** Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
7.  **Shape:** Turn the dough out onto a floured surface and shape into a 1-inch thick circle.
8.  **Cut** into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet.
9.  **Finish:** Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
10. **Bake** for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
11. **Cool** on a wire rack before serving.

Enjoy your scones warm with clotted cream or your favorite jam!

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.content:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

A delightful recipe for flaky, buttery blueberry scones with a hint of lemon zest.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, chilled and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh or frozen blueberries
  • 1 large egg
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Zest of 1 lemon

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the chilled butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in the blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together egg, heavy cream, vanilla extract, and lemon zest.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a floured surface and shape into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
  11. Cool on a wire rack before serving.

Enjoy these scones warm with clotted cream or your favorite jam!

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.content:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

A delightful recipe for flaky, buttery blueberry scones with a hint of lemon zest.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, chilled and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh or frozen blueberries
  • 1 large egg
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Zest of 1 lemon

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the chilled butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in the blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together egg, heavy cream, vanilla extract, and lemon zest.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a floured surface and shape into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
  11. Cool on a wire rack before serving.

Enjoy these scones warm with clotted cream or your favorite jam!

data.html_content:
The Coded Culinary

Blueberry Scones

Prep Time: 15 minutesCook Time: 20 minutesTotal Time: 35 minutesServings: 8 scones

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

For the glaze:

  • 1 cup powdered sugar
  • 2-3 tablespoons milk
  • 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in the blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into an 8-inch circle. Cut into 8 wedges.
  8. Place wedges on the prepared baking sheet. Bake for 18-20 minutes or until golden brown.
  9. While scones cool, whisk together powdered sugar, milk, and vanilla to make the glaze. Drizzle over scones.
  10. Serve warm. Enjoy!

data.content:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

A delightful recipe for flaky, buttery blueberry scones with a hint of lemon zest.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, chilled and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh or frozen blueberries
  • 1 large egg
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Zest of 1 lemon

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the chilled butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in the blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together egg, heavy cream, vanilla extract, and lemon zest.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a floured surface and shape into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
  11. Cool on a wire rack before serving.

Enjoy these scones warm with clotted cream or your favorite jam!

data.html_content:
The Coded Culinary

Blueberry Scones

Prep Time: 15 minutesCook Time: 20 minutesTotal Time: 35 minutesServings: 8 scones

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

For the glaze:

  • 1 cup powdered sugar
  • 2-3 tablespoons milk
  • 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in the blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into an 8-inch circle. Cut into 8 wedges.
  8. Place wedges on the prepared baking sheet. Bake for 18-20 minutes or until golden brown.
  9. While scones cool, whisk together powdered sugar, milk, and vanilla to make the glaze. Drizzle over scones.
  10. Serve warm. Enjoy!

  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a floured surface and shape into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
  11. Cool on a wire rack before serving.

data.page_title: Blueberry Scones Recipe - The Coded Culinary
data.html_content:
The Coded Culinary

Blueberry Scones

Prep Time: 15 minutesCook Time: 20 minutesTotal Time: 35 minutesServings: 8 scones

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

For the glaze:

  • 1 cup powdered sugar
  • 2-3 tablespoons milk
  • 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in the blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into an 8-inch circle. Cut into 8 wedges.
  8. Place wedges on the prepared baking sheet. Bake for 18-20 minutes or until golden brown.
  9. While scones cool, whisk together powdered sugar, milk, and vanilla to make the glaze. Drizzle over scones.
  10. Serve warm. Enjoy!

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.content:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

A delightful recipe for flaky, buttery blueberry scones with a hint of lemon zest.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, chilled and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh or frozen blueberries
  • 1 large egg
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Zest of 1 lemon

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the chilled butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in the blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together egg, heavy cream, vanilla extract, and lemon zest.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a floured surface and shape into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
  11. Cool on a wire rack before serving.

Enjoy these scones warm with clotted cream or your favorite jam!

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.content:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

A delightful recipe for flaky, buttery blueberry scones with a hint of lemon zest.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, chilled and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh or frozen blueberries
  • 1 large egg
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Zest of 1 lemon

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the chilled butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in the blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together egg, heavy cream, vanilla extract, and lemon zest.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a floured surface and shape into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
  11. Cool on a wire rack before serving.

Enjoy these scones warm with clotted cream or your favorite jam!

data.page_title: Blueberry Scones Recipe - The Coded Culinary
data.html_content:
The Coded Culinary

Blueberry Scones

Prep Time: 15 minutesCook Time: 20 minutesTotal Time: 35 minutesServings: 8 scones

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

For the glaze:

  • 1 cup powdered sugar
  • 2-3 tablespoons milk
  • 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in the blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into an 8-inch circle. Cut into 8 wedges.
  8. Place wedges on the prepared baking sheet. Bake for 18-20 minutes or until golden brown.
  9. While scones cool, whisk together powdered sugar, milk, and vanilla to make the glaze. Drizzle over scones.
  10. Serve warm. Enjoy!

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.content:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

A delightful recipe for flaky, buttery blueberry scones with a hint of lemon zest.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, chilled and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh or frozen blueberries
  • 1 large egg
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Zest of 1 lemon

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the chilled butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in the blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together egg, heavy cream, vanilla extract, and lemon zest.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a floured surface and shape into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
  11. Cool on a wire rack before serving.

Enjoy these scones warm with clotted cream or your favorite jam!

data.page_title: Blueberry Scones Recipe - The Coded Culinary
data.html_content:
The Coded Culinary

Blueberry Scones

Prep Time: 15 minutesCook Time: 20 minutesTotal Time: 35 minutesServings: 8 scones

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

For the glaze:

  • 1 cup powdered sugar
  • 2-3 tablespoons milk
  • 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in the blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into an 8-inch circle. Cut into 8 wedges.
  8. Place wedges on the prepared baking sheet. Bake for 18-20 minutes or until golden brown.
  9. While scones cool, whisk together powdered sugar, milk, and vanilla to make the glaze. Drizzle over scones.
  10. Serve warm. Enjoy!

data.html_content:
Coded Culinary

Home | Recipes | Baking | About

Classic Blueberry Scones

Yield: 8 scones | Prep Time: 15 minutes | Cook Time: 18 minutes

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh or frozen blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Coarse sugar for topping (optional)

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla. Add to dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  6. Turn dough onto a lightly floured surface and shape into an 8-inch disk. Cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place wedges on prepared baking sheet. Brush with extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  8. Bake for 16-18 minutes until golden brown. Cool slightly before serving.

Tips

  • For best results, keep all ingredients cold.
  • Do not overmix the dough to avoid tough scones.
  • Serve warm with clotted cream or jam.

Related Recipes

  • Lemon Poppy Seed Scones
  • Chocolate Chip Scones

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.content:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

A delightful recipe for flaky, buttery blueberry scones with a hint of lemon zest.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, chilled and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh or frozen blueberries
  • 1 large egg
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Zest of 1 lemon

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the chilled butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in the blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together egg, heavy cream, vanilla extract, and lemon zest.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a floured surface and shape into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
  11. Cool on a wire rack before serving.

Enjoy these scones warm with clotted cream or your favorite jam!

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.content:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

A delightful recipe for flaky, buttery blueberry scones with a hint of lemon zest.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, chilled and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh or frozen blueberries
  • 1 large egg
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Zest of 1 lemon

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the chilled butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in the blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together egg, heavy cream, vanilla extract, and lemon zest.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a floured surface and shape into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
  11. Cool on a wire rack before serving.

Enjoy these scones warm with clotted cream or your favorite jam!

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.content:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

A delightful recipe for flaky, buttery blueberry scones with a hint of lemon zest.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, chilled and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh or frozen blueberries
  • 1 large egg
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Zest of 1 lemon

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the chilled butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in the blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together egg, heavy cream, vanilla extract, and lemon zest.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a floured surface and shape into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
  11. Cool on a wire rack before serving.

Enjoy these scones warm with clotted cream or your favorite jam!

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.content:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

A delightful recipe for flaky, buttery blueberry scones with a hint of lemon zest.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, chilled and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh or frozen blueberries
  • 1 large egg
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Zest of 1 lemon

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the chilled butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in the blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together egg, heavy cream, vanilla extract, and lemon zest.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a floured surface and shape into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
  11. Cool on a wire rack before serving.

Enjoy these scones warm with clotted cream or your favorite jam!

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.content:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

A delightful recipe for flaky, buttery blueberry scones with a hint of lemon zest.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, chilled and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh or frozen blueberries
  • 1 large egg
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Zest of 1 lemon

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the chilled butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in the blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together egg, heavy cream, vanilla extract, and lemon zest.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a floured surface and shape into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
  11. Cool on a wire rack before serving.

Enjoy these scones warm with clotted cream or your favorite jam!

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.content:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

A delightful recipe for flaky, buttery blueberry scones with a hint of lemon zest.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, chilled and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh or frozen blueberries
  • 1 large egg
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Zest of 1 lemon

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the chilled butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in the blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together egg, heavy cream, vanilla extract, and lemon zest.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a floured surface and shape into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
  11. Cool on a wire rack before serving.

Enjoy these scones warm with clotted cream or your favorite jam!

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.content:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

A delightful recipe for flaky, buttery blueberry scones with a hint of lemon zest.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, chilled and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh or frozen blueberries
  • 1 large egg
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Zest of 1 lemon

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the chilled butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in the blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together egg, heavy cream, vanilla extract, and lemon zest.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a floured surface and shape into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
  11. Cool on a wire rack before serving.

Enjoy these scones warm with clotted cream or your favorite jam!

data.page_title: Blueberry Scones Recipe - The Coded Culinary
data.html_content:
The Coded Culinary

Blueberry Scones

Prep Time: 15 minutesCook Time: 20 minutesTotal Time: 35 minutesServings: 8 scones

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

For the glaze:

  • 1 cup powdered sugar
  • 2-3 tablespoons milk
  • 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in the blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into an 8-inch circle. Cut into 8 wedges.
  8. Place wedges on the prepared baking sheet. Bake for 18-20 minutes or until golden brown.
  9. While scones cool, whisk together powdered sugar, milk, and vanilla to make the glaze. Drizzle over scones.
  10. Serve warm. Enjoy!
